The PKGBUILD defines two sources: a prebuilt Arch package from the ungoogled-chromium GitHub releases and a Google Chrome `.deb` package from Google's official domain (`dl.google.com`). The global scope contains only variable assignments and array definitions — no command substitutions, function calls, or immediate executions. The `pkgver()` function is absent, so no dynamic version computation occurs. The `prepare()`, `package()`, and `check()` functions are defined but will not be executed due to the `--noprepare` and `--nobuild` flags. Therefore, no code that manipulates or extracts files runs during this phase.

Fetching and sourcing this PKGBUILD with `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` is safe. It will only download the two binaries using verified URLs and parse the metadata, with no execution of extracted content or untrusted code.
</details>
